title: Non-Square Jacobi SVD HDL Optimized
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/Non_Square_Jacobi_SVD_HDL_Optimized.md
text: Fixed-point singular value decomposition, 4 inputs, 5 outputs, {Select outputs} sets Block outputs; {Number of rows in matrix A} sets the number of rows in m -by- n matrix, {Number of columns in matrix A} sets the number of columns in m -by- n matrix, {Number of Jacobi iterations} sets the number of iterations of Jacobi algorithm and {Signal type} sets the complexity of input matrix. Values come from the instance.
